alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Central outflow, slow disk wind, and orthogonal inner disk rejected on kinematic grounds

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Differential stellar heating cannot explain the N-S contrast

evidence.quote: Differential stellar heating, on its own, cannot account for the observed north-south contrast of $28\pm0.5$.
